                                        ABSTRACT                                                                   The advent of app stores opens an opportunity to mine millions
                                        We introduce Frontmatter: a tool to automatically mine both             of apps for user interfaces and their properties. Apps can be an-
                                        user interface models and behavior of Android apps at a large scale     alyzed dynamically by executing them. However, this approach
                                        with high precision. Given an app, Frontmatter statically extracts      raises the test generation problem, namely to synthesize appropri-
                                        all declared screens, the user interface elements, their textual and    ate interactions in order to reach and cover the entire user interface.
                                        graphical features, as well as Android APIs invoked by interact-        Addressing this problem can be quite expensive. For instance, the
                                        ing with them. Executed on tens of thousands of real-world apps,        developers of the Rico dataset [11] spent $19,200 for crowdsourcing
                                        Frontmatter opens the door for comprehensive mining of mobile           user traces to analyze 9,7K applications. However, the executable
                                        user interfaces, jumpstarting empirical research at a large scale,      code of apps is also available for static analysis. This opens the
                                        addressing questions such as “How many travel apps require reg-         opportunity to analyze millions of apps for the way they interact
                                        istration?”, “Which apps do not follow accessibility guidelines?”,      with users—and thus jumpstarting empirical research on user inter-
                                        “Does the user interface correspond to the description?”, and many      faces at a large scale. Which apps require a password? How many
                                        more. Frontmatter and the mined dataset are available under an          of these allow for simple password recovery? Which apps allow to
                                        open-source license.                                                    contact the vendor, and how? Is the concept of a “shopping cart”
                                                                                                                universally adopted? How do these things change over time?
                                        KEYWORDS                                                                   Many of these questions could be answered by statically min-
                                                                                                                ing app user interfaces. Alas, static analysis of apps and their user
                                        App mining, user interfaces, Android, app stores, static analysis       interfaces is not exactly easy either. The challenges are manifold:

                                        1    INTRODUCTION                                                           • A user interface analysis should be complete, that is, take the
                                        When designing a user interface, a good practice is to follow the             entire user interface into account. Yet, parts of the user inter-
                                        conventions as set by other user interfaces. But what are these               face may be constructed programmatically, which requires
                                        conventions exactly? While there are myriads of different user                the analysis to identify (and interpret) the constructing code.
                                        interfaces around us, automated empirical analysis of these UIs is a        • A user interface analysis should be precise, that is, properly
                                        surprisingly difficult task.                                                  identify user interface elements, correctly associate them
                                           The Web, for instance, sports billions of Web pages. Yet, those            with each other as well as related code locations. An impre-
                                        Web sites that actually are accessible for empirical analysis only            cise analysis (say, simply extracting all fixed strings from an
                                        form the “surface Web”, with the much larger “deep Web” requiring             executable and its resources) may retrieve all user interface
                                        specific user inputs (such as passwords) to be accessible. To analyze         labels (among many other things), but will not be able to
                                        all pages of a Web application, an automated analysis thus has                properly group and organize them.
                                        to synthesize such inputs, which brings all the problems of test            • A user interface analysis should scale, that is, be applicable
                                        generation. To automatically reach and explore millions of Web                to the large majority of apps as found in app stores. Scal-
                                        applications, one would have to synthesize interactions for all of            ability is an issue because a precise and complete analysis
                                        these, which is hard—and in many cases (passwords, internal web               typically takes time—possibly too much time for the analysis
                                        pages) simply impossible.                                                     of hundreds of thousands of apps.
